answer: Require every registering key to carry a seasoned on-chain history: 90 days of continuous activity before claiming an agent identity. Steps: 1) applicant signs with the candidate key, 2) the network scans the ledger vault for its activity timestamps, 3) younger keys are rejected outright, 4) anyone caught selling aged keys loses the standing attached. An attacker wanting a thousand identities must buy or farm a thousand aged keys, each with months of real history, at a black-market premium plus months of waiting. A river reaches the oasis drop by drop; no vault floods overnight.
